exercise.name: Reverse Preacher Curl
library_steps: Sit at the preacher bench and grip an EZ bar or bar palms down.
Keep your arms on the pad and curl the bar up.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
exercise.one_line_summary: Seated at a preacher bench, upper arms flat on the sloped pad, a bar held palms down; the elbows bend from nearly straight to ~120 deg. Brachioradialis (forearm) does the most, biceps helps.

setup.target: Upper arms along the sloped pad, armpits over its top edge.
setup.why: Library step 2; OLIV fixed the upper arm on a preacher pad.
Library step 1; a pronated hand shifts work to the brachioradialis (KLEI).

muscles.emg: Brachioradialis contribution clearly higher with the hand pronated than supinated (KLEI).
muscles.role: Helps bend the elbow, most with the palm turned down.
muscles.surface: Thumb side of the upper forearm.

muscles.emg: Main elbow flexor in curls; above 50 % of max RMS in standing and preacher curls.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Elbows rise off the pad as the bar comes up.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Loses the fixed-arm set-up that defines the preacher curl.

sources.citation: Kleiber T, Kunz L, Disselhorst-Klug C. 2015. Muscular coordination of biceps brachii and brachioradialis in elbow flexion with respect to hand position. Front Physiol 6:215.
sources.what_it_gave: Elbow flexion with pronated, neutral and supinated hands: the brachioradialis share rose clearly with the hand pronated (palm down) while biceps activity did not change significantly.

sources.citation: Oliveira LF, Matta TT, Alves DS, Garcia MA, Vieira TM. 2009. Effect of the shoulder position on the biceps brachii EMG in different dumbbell curls. J Sports Sci Med 8(1):24-29.
sources.what_it_gave: Standing, incline and preacher curls: biceps long head above 50 % of max RMS in all; with the upper arm fixed in front (preacher) the biceps worked hardest only over a short early range.

sources.citation: Lung BE, Ekblad J, Bisogno M. 2024. Anatomy, Shoulder and Upper Limb, Forearm Brachioradialis Muscle. StatPearls (NCBI Bookshelf).
sources.what_it_gave: Brachioradialis: forearm muscle on the thumb side that flexes the elbow and does not cross the wrist.

clip_check.check: Upper arms on the pad face
